title: XMD-001: ASINH's overflow boundary is identified by witness, with no row count
status_plain: Excel evaluates the literal `ln(x + sqrt(x^2+1))`, so the x^2 intermediate overflows f64 and publishes #NUM! well below where the mathematical result would. The mechanism is identified; no count is published. The kernel additionally claims agreement in every bit on the disputed lanes where platform libm asinh differs by one or more ULP -- also with no denominator.
evidence_locality_note: The oracle script cited by the entry (`.tmp/asinh-sqrtpi-oracle2.ps1`) is under `.tmp/`, which is gitignored in OxFunc.
substrate: the literal `ln(x + sqrt(x^2+1))`, overflowing at the x^2 intermediate
reader_warning: An exactness claim with no denominator is not a count. This record publishes none.
citations: content/evidence/harvest/RV-w108-elementary.md — the primary-source re-derivation this record follows
